title: Enterprise notebook templates
objectives: Build Silver tables, Gold dimensions and facts from the enterprise templates
Fill in only the Parameters cell, so the notebook stays supportable
Declare a fact's grain and keep degenerate and descriptive fields out of it
Check a notebook and hand it over to the enterprise, or keep it as domain-owned work

exercises.prompt: Fix the fact query. Keep only the keys and measures (order_sk, customer_sk, amount, net_amount), take the customer version that was valid on the order date, and send an order whose customer isn't in the dimension to the Unknown member (-1). Order by order_sk.
hints: order_id and status describe the order: they belong in dim_order, and the fact keeps order_sk.
A Type 2 version is valid when valid_from <= order_date < valid_to. The current version is the wrong one for an order placed before the change.
Use a LEFT JOIN and COALESCE(c.customer_sk, -1), and leave the Unknown member out of the join so it is only ever the fallback.
